financings_after_balance_sheet.what: January 2021 ATM offering completed via Maxim, 15,359,000 shares sold
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: On January 15, 2021, we completed the January 2021 ATM Offering, pursuant to which we sold an aggregate of 15,359,000 shares of our common stock, raised gross proceeds of approximately $10,000,000 and net proceeds of approximately $9,500,000.

warrants.quote: As of September 30, 2020, the Company had an aggregate of 15,452,988 outstanding warrants to purchase shares of its common stock with a weighted average exercise price of $0.39
